Here is a Python solution for generating a palindrome that's more than 255 characters long:

```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    if length <= 1:
        return ''
    
    half_length = (length + 1) // 2
    
    first_half = ''.join([chr(i) for i in range(97, 123)])
    second_half = first_half[:half_length][::-1]
    
    palindrome = first_half + second_half
    
    if length % 2 != 0:
        middle_char = chr((97 + 122) // 2)
        palindrome += middle_char
        
    return palindrome

print(generate_palindrome(256))
```

This script generates a string consisting of the alphabet (a-z), followed by the reverse of the alphabet. If the desired length is odd, it adds an extra character in the middle to make it a true palindrome.

Please note that this solution will only work up to a certain point because there are only 26 letters in the English alphabet. If you want a longer palindrome with more characters, you would need to include numbers or symbols in your alphabet.
